verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. /reference/ pages for monitoring, exports, audit, and transactions) and a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. It also ships an official Postman collection, which gives runnable requests, though only inside Postman rather than the reference itself. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console or embedded runnable code samples. Missing for 10: documented in-page interactive 'try it' execution, runnable code examples within the reference, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
